item.title: NASA WB-57F Canberra Jet Makes Fiery Belly-Landing In Houston (Updated)
item.description: NASA has a fleet of just three of the high-flying WB-57F aircraft, which are used for a wide array of scientific and defense-related missions. The post NASA WB-57F Canberra Jet Makes Fiery Belly-Landing In Houston (Updated) appeared first on The War Zone.

item.title: Canada Accelerates Armor Plans To Contend With Growing Threats
item.description: Canada wants at least 250 new armored fighting vehicles, followed by new tanks, as it faces the challenges of an increasingly contested High North. The post Canada Accelerates Armor Plans To Contend With Growing Threats appeared first on The War Zone.

item.title: New EA-37B Compass Call Electronic Warfare Jet Makes Maiden Voyage To Europe
item.description: The Air Force is showing off the Compass Call jet's capabilities to airmen as it transitions away from the aging EC-130 turboprop planes. The post New EA-37B Compass Call Electronic Warfare Jet Makes Maiden Voyage To Europe appeared first on The War Zone.

item.title: Flying F-4 Reconnaissance Phantoms Unarmed And Unafraid In Desert Storm
item.description: Distinguished Flying Cross recipient RF-4C pilot and his weapon systems officer recollect flying some of the most important recon missions of the war. The post Flying F-4 Reconnaissance Phantoms Unarmed And Unafraid In Desert Storm appeared first on The War Zone.
